recentItems.title: New on Disney+ | September 2026
recentItems.description:
Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming to Disney+ and Hulu on Disney+ for bundle subscribers in September 2026:

September 2 – Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
September 2 – LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian
September 2 – Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu Podcast
September 3 – Chad Powers (Season 2 Premiere | All Episodes)
September 8 – FX's The Drop: A Snowfall Saga (Season Premiere)
September 9 – Made in Korea (Season 2 | New Episodes)
September 15 & 16 – Dancing With the Stars (Season 35 | Two-Night Premiere)
September 16 – R.J. Decker (Season 2 | Premiere)
September 18-19 – iHeartRadio Music Festival (Livestream)
September 23 – Toy Story 5
September 24 – FX’s American Horror Story: 13 (Three-Episode Premiere) 
Thursdays – Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday Official Podcast
